<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0c1318">
<meta name="description" content="An offline, layered snow-globe panorama. Explore a winter village from inside the glass, turn the surrounding room independently, and stir the falling snow.">
<title>Snow Globe — Immersive Winter Edition</title>
<style>:root {
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#0c151b; --panel:#132029; --panel-deep:#0e1921;
  --gold:#ddc595; --gold-bright:#f0ddba; --ink:#f1eee4; --muted:#afbbb6; --quiet:#93a49f;
  --line:#d7c6a322; --line-strong:#d7c6a33d; --sidebar:272px; --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.25,1);
  font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  font-synthesis:none; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
body{overflow:hidden}
button,select,input{font:inherit;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
button,select{color:var(--ink)}
button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;margin:0;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:7px;background:#1a2c36;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.005em;touch-action:manipulation;transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease,color .16s ease}
@media(hover:hover){button:hover{background:#263b45;border-color:#d7c6a369}}
button:active{background:#304550}
button:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default}
button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#ddc59513;border-color:#ddc59563;color:var(--gold-bright)}
button.primary,.actions #fullscreen{color:#17232b;background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);font-weight:650}
@media(hover:hover){button.primary:hover,.actions #fullscreen:hover{background:#ecdbb9;border-color:#ecdbb9}}
button.icon{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:42px;min-width:42px;padding:10px}
button svg{display:block;flex:none;width:17px;height:17px}
button .button-label{display:inline}
a{color:var(--gold);text-underline-offset:3px}
:is(button,select,input,summary,a):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-bright);outline-offset:3px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
.app{height:100vh;height:100dvh;display:grid;grid-template-rows:56px minmax(0,1fr);overflow:hidden}
header{position:relative;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:0 24px;background:#0d181f;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0}
.mark{display:grid;place-items:center;width:31px;height:31px;flex:none;border:1px solid #ddc59547;border-radius:50%;color:var(--gold);font:21px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
.mark svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.brand-title,.brand strong{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:9px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.2em}
.brand-sub,.brand small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#a7b5ae;font-size:8px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.1em}
.offline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:#b1c2b8;font-size:8px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.1em;text-align:right}
.offline::before{display:none}
.status-dot{width:4px;height:4px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:#b6c7b1}
.main{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--sidebar) minmax(0,1fr);min-width:0;min-height:0}
.reader{position:relative;z-index:10;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel)}
.reader-head{position:relative;flex:none;padding:21px 23px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-size:8px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
.reader h1{margin:9px 0 10px;color:var(--ink);font:400 34px/1.03 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.reader h1 em{color:var(--gold-bright);font-weight:400}
.intro{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;letter-spacing:.005em}
.controls{flex:1;min-height:0;padding:0 23px;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#7b705b #132029}
.controls::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
.controls::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{border-radius:8px;background:#7b705b}
.control-group{padding:18px 0 19px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.control-group:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.control-group h3,.control-head h3{margin:0;color:#d1bd98;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.control-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.control-head>span{color:#9caaa3;font-size:8px;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.025em}
.control-group>h3{margin-bottom:12px}
.control-group>p,.control-note{margin:10px 0 0;color:#a9b7b0;font-size:10px;line-height:1.65}
.range-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:11px}
.range-row:first-child{margin-top:0}
.range-label,.range-row>label{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;color:#d2d9d1;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55}
.range-value{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;color:#ead4ac;font-size:10px;line-height:1.55;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.01em}
input[type="range"]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;height:42px;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;touch-action:pan-y;accent-color:var(--gold)}
.range-row>input[type="range"]{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:2}
.range-row+input[type="range"]{margin-top:-2px;margin-bottom:-4px}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:2px;border-radius:3px;background:#52616a}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track{height:2px;border-radius:3px;background:#52616a}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-progress{height:2px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--gold)}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:12px;height:12px;margin-top:-5px;border:1px solid #f4e5c9;border-radius:50%;background:#ddc595;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0004}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb{width:10px;height:10px;border:1px solid #f4e5c9;border-radius:50%;background:#ddc595;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #0004}
input[type="range"]:active::-webkit-slider-thumb{background:#f0ddba}
input[type="range"]:active::-moz-range-thumb{background:#f0ddba}
input[type="range"]:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
.segmented{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:3px;padding:3px;border:1px solid #d7c6a320;border-radius:8px;background:#09151b80}
.segmented button{min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:8px 5px;border-color:transparent;border-radius:5px;color:#aebbb3;background:transparent;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}
@media(hover:hover){.segmented button:hover{color:var(--ink);background:#ffffff06}}
.segmented button[aria-pressed="true"],.segmented button.active,.segmented button[aria-selected="true"]{color:#f0ddba;background:#2a373d;border-color:#ddc59542;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0002}
.control-group>button{width:100%}
.reader-foot{flex:none;padding:13px 23px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:#c5b691;font-size:7px;line-height:1.8;letter-spacing:.1em}
.reader-foot span,.reader-foot p{color:#9dafa5;font-size:9px;line-height:1.7;letter-spacing:0}
.reader-foot p{margin:0}
.reader-foot strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}
.reader-foot .key-hint{margin-top:7px;color:var(--quiet);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em}
kbd{display:inline-block;min-width:17px;margin:0 1px;padding:1px 4px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:3px;color:#d1d8cc;background:#0d1820;font-family:inherit;font-size:9px;line-height:1.5;text-align:center}
.world{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:#0a141b;container-type:inline-size}
.world::after{display:none;content:none}
.world canvas,#panorama{display:block;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;outline:0}
.world canvas:active,#panorama:active{cursor:grabbing}
#panorama:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-bright);outline-offset:-5px}
.topbar{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:20px;left:20px;right:20px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;pointer-events:none}
.scene-card{flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:300px;padding:11px 14px 12px;border:1px solid #d7c6a32b;border-radius:9px;color:var(--ink);background:#0d1a22d9;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0001}
.scene-card .eyebrow{color:#ddc9a3;font-size:7px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.15em}
.scene-card h2{margin:6px 0 0;font:400 22px/1.14 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.scene-status{margin-top:6px;color:#c0cac0;font-size:9px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.005em}
.actions{display:flex;flex:none;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;max-width:60%;pointer-events:auto}
.actions button{min-height:42px;border-color:#dccfb530;border-radius:7px;background:#101e27e8;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 2px 7px #0001}
@media(hover:hover){.actions button:hover{background:#263b45f2;border-color:#ddc5956e}}
.actions button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--gold-bright);background:#30423be8;border-color:#ddc5956e}
.actions button.icon{width:42px;min-width:42px;padding:10px}
.actions #help{min-width:42px;padding:9px 13px}
.actions #help.icon{padding:10px}
.bottom{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:20px;right:20px;bottom:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;pointer-events:none}
.view-caption{max-width:460px;margin:0;color:#f2ead9;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 1px 6px #000b,0 1px 2px #000;font:400 15px/1.45 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:.005em}
.view-caption p{margin:0}
.view-caption .eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:5px;color:#f0d5a3;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.17em}
.dock{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;max-width:100%;padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddc59536;border-radius:10px;background:#0d1b24ed;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0003;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);pointer-events:auto}
.dock button{min-height:42px;min-width:0;flex:none;padding:9px 12px;border-color:transparent;border-radius:6px;color:#dbe0d5;background:transparent;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}
@media(hover:hover){.dock button:hover{background:#ffffff09;border-color:#d7c6a32b}}
.dock button.icon{width:42px;min-width:42px;padding:10px;color:#e2ddcc;background:#ffffff04;font-size:18px;font-weight:400}
.dock button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--gold-bright);background:#ddc59517;border-color:#ddc5955c}
.dock button.primary{color:#17232b;background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold)}
.dock #shake{color:#ead6b2;background:#ddc5950d;border-color:#ddc5952c}
.dock .separator,.dock-divider{width:1px;height:20px;flex:none;margin:0 3px;background:#d7c6a32c}
.dock select{flex:1;width:170px;min-width:0;max-width:230px;min-height:42px;padding:9px 25px 9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:6px;background:#1a2b35;font-size:11px}
.meta-line{display:flex;align-self:stretch;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:#eef0e4c7;font-size:7px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.08em;text-shadow:0 1px 5px #000,0 1px 2px #000}
.meta-line>:last-child{text-align:right}
.loading{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:8;display:grid;place-content:center;padding:30px;color:var(--gold);text-align:center;background:#101e27}
.loading strong{font:400 29px/1.2 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.loading p{max-width:310px;margin:13px auto 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.8}
.spinner{width:28px;height:28px;margin:0 auto 23px;border:1px solid #ddc5952c;border-top-color:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;animation:spin 1.4s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.help-panel{position:absolute;z-index:16;top:77px;right:20px;width:min(330px,calc(100% - 40px));max-height:calc(100% - 97px);padding:20px 22px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;border:1px solid #ddc59547;border-radius:11px;color:#cbd5ca;background:#11212af5;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0005;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;touch-action:pan-y}
.help-panel h3{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--gold);font:400 22px/1.2 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
.help-panel p{margin:0 0 13px}
.help-panel p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.help-panel strong,.help-panel b{color:#ead7b3;font-weight:550}
.help-panel .notice{margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:#b3c0b6;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7}
.help-panel .close,.reader-close{position:absolute;top:9px;right:9px}
.mobile-settings,.reader-close{display:none}
.world:fullscreen,html.pseudo-full .world{width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100dvh;border:0}
html.pseudo-full .world{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;visibility:visible}
html.pseudo-full .app{visibility:hidden}
html.pseudo-full .world [hidden]{display:none!important}
.world:fullscreen .topbar,html.pseudo-full .world .topbar{top:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-top))}
.world:fullscreen .bottom,html.pseudo-full .world .bottom{bottom:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
@container(max-width:620px){
 .topbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px;left:15px;right:15px;top:15px}
 .topbar>.scene-card{max-width:100%;justify-self:start;padding:10px 12px 11px}
 .scene-card h2{font-size:20px}
 .actions{display:flex;gap:5px;width:auto;max-width:none}
 .actions button{width:42px;min-width:42px;min-height:42px;padding:10px;font-size:10px}
 .actions .button-label{display:none}
 .actions #help{width:42px;padding:10px;justify-self:auto}
 .actions:not(:has(>button:not(.icon))){display:flex;width:auto}
 .bottom{left:15px;right:15px;bottom:13px;gap:11px}
 .view-caption{max-width:350px;font-size:14px}
 .dock{display:grid;width:min(100%,480px);grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:5px}
 .dock button{min-width:0;width:auto;padding:9px 6px}
 .dock #modeToggle,.dock #shake{grid-column:span 3}
 .dock #zoomOut,.dock #zoomIn,.dock #reset{grid-column:span 2;width:auto}
 .dock .separator,.dock-divider{display:none}
 .meta-line .instruction{display:none}
}
@media(min-width:1500px){.topbar{top:24px;left:24px;right:24px}.bottom{left:24px;right:24px;bottom:18px}}
@media(max-width:760px),(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){
 .app{grid-template-rows:53px minmax(0,1fr)}
 header{gap:12px;padding:0 14px}
 .brand{gap:9px}
 .mark{width:29px;height:29px;font-size:19px}
 .mark svg{width:18px;height:18px}
 .brand-title,.brand strong{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.17em}
 .brand-sub,.brand small{margin-top:2px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.06em}
 .offline{max-width:106px;gap:5px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.055em}
 .main{display:block}
 .world{width:100%;height:100%}
 .reader{position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:10px;width:auto;height:min(574px,calc(100% - 87px));max-height:calc(100% - 87px);border:1px solid #ddc59545;border-radius:14px;background:#13232df7;box-shadow:0 6px 35px #0006;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);transform:translateY(calc(100% + 20px));visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .28s var(--ease),visibility .28s;z-index:20}
 .reader.open{transform:translateY(0);visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
 .reader-head{padding:19px 21px 18px}
 .reader h1{padding-right:33px;margin:7px 0 0;font-size:29px;line-height:1.1}
 .reader h1 br{display:none}
 .reader-head .intro{display:none}
 .reader .eyebrow{padding-right:38px;font-size:8px}
 .controls{padding:0 21px}
 .control-group{padding:18px 0}
 .control-group h3,.control-head h3{font-size:9px}
 .control-head>span{font-size:8px}
 .range-label,.range-row>label{font-size:12px}
 .range-value{font-size:11px}
 .control-group>p,.control-note{font-size:11px}
 .segmented button{font-size:11px}
 .reader-foot{display:none}
 .reader-close{display:inline-grid;border-color:transparent;background:transparent}
 .mobile-settings,button.mobile-settings{display:inline-flex}
 .topbar{top:14px;left:12px;right:12px;gap:10px}
 .scene-card{max-width:100%;padding:10px 12px 11px}
 .scene-card .eyebrow{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.13em}
 .scene-card h2{font-size:20px;line-height:1.13}
 .scene-status{max-width:24ch;margin-top:6px;font-size:8px;line-height:1.5}
 .actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px 84px;width:131px;gap:5px;max-width:none}
 .actions button{min-height:42px;padding:9px 8px;font-size:10px}
 .actions button.icon{width:42px;min-width:42px;padding:10px}
 .actions #pauseMotion{grid-column:1/-1}
 .actions #help{justify-self:start;padding:9px}
 .actions .desktop-label{display:none}
 .bottom{left:12px;right:12px;bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));gap:11px}
 .view-caption{max-width:320px;padding:0 5px;font-size:14px}
 .dock button{min-height:42px;font-size:10px}
 .dock #zoomOut,.dock #zoomIn{grid-column:span 1}
 .dock #reset,.dock #settingsToggle{grid-column:span 2}
 .meta-line{gap:7px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.045em}
 .meta-line .instruction{display:none}
 .help-panel{top:109px;right:12px;width:min(330px,calc(100% - 24px));max-height:calc(100% - 125px);padding:19px 21px}
 .world:fullscreen .topbar,html.pseudo-full .world .topbar{top:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-top))}
 .world:fullscreen .bottom,html.pseudo-full .world .bottom{bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .dock{display:grid;width:min(100%,480px);grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:5px}
 .dock button,.dock button.icon{min-width:0;width:auto;padding:9px 5px}
 .dock #modeToggle,.dock #shake{grid-column:span 3}
 .dock #zoomOut,.dock #zoomIn{grid-column:span 1}
 .dock #reset,.dock #settingsToggle{grid-column:span 2}
 .dock .separator,.dock-divider{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:370px){
 header{padding:0 11px}.brand{gap:7px}.brand-title,.brand strong{font-size:7px}.brand-sub,.brand small{font-size:6px}.offline{max-width:94px;font-size:6px}
 .topbar{left:10px;right:10px;gap:8px}.scene-card{padding:9px 10px 10px}.scene-card h2{font-size:18px}.scene-status{font-size:8px}.bottom{left:9px;right:9px}.view-caption{font-size:13px}
}
@media(max-height:640px) and (min-width:761px){
 .reader-head{padding-top:17px;padding-bottom:16px}.reader h1{margin-top:7px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:30px}.reader-head .intro{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6}.control-group{padding-top:16px;padding-bottom:17px}.reader-foot{padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:11px}
}
@media(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){
 .app{grid-template-rows:46px minmax(0,1fr)}.brand-sub,.brand small{display:none}.offline{max-width:none}
 .reader{left:auto;right:10px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:310px;height:calc(100% - 20px);max-height:none;border-radius:11px;transform:translateX(calc(100% + 20px))}
 .reader.open{transform:translateX(0)}.reader-head{padding:15px 20px 14px}.reader h1{margin-top:5px;font-size:26px}.controls{padding:0 20px}.control-group{padding-top:15px;padding-bottom:16px}
 .topbar{display:flex;top:11px;left:13px;right:13px}.scene-card{max-width:40%;padding:9px 12px 10px}.scene-card h2{margin-top:4px;font-size:19px}.scene-status{display:none}
 .actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;width:auto;max-width:60%}
 .bottom{gap:7px;left:13px;right:13px;bottom:10px}.view-caption{display:none}.dock{display:flex;width:auto;gap:3px}.dock button{padding-left:11px;padding-right:11px}.dock button.icon{width:42px;min-width:42px;padding:10px}.meta-line{display:none}.help-panel{top:65px;max-height:calc(100% - 78px)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 *,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:0s!important;animation-duration:0s!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important}.spinner{animation:none;border-top-color:var(--gold);border-right-color:var(--gold)}
}
@media(forced-colors:active){button,.segmented button,.dock,.reader,.scene-card{border:1px solid CanvasText}button[aria-pressed="true"]{outline:2px solid Highlight;outline-offset:-3px}input[type="range"]{appearance:auto}}

/* Actual page controls and states. Keep after ui.css. */
.wide-button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:5px 0 10px;padding:10px 11px;text-align:left;font-size:10px}
.toggle-state{flex:none;color:var(--gold);font-size:8px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.11em}
.wide-button[aria-pressed="true"] .toggle-state{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.wide-button[aria-pressed="true"] .toggle-state::before{content:"";width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.upload-buttons{display:grid;gap:6px}
.upload-buttons button{justify-content:flex-start;padding:10px 11px;border-color:#d7c6a32e;background:#1b2c35;text-align:left;font-size:10px}
@media(hover:hover){.upload-buttons button:hover{background:#283d46;border-color:#ddc59563}}
.text-button{justify-content:flex-start;min-height:42px;padding:9px 0;border:0;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold);background:transparent;text-align:left;font-size:10px}
@media(hover:hover){.text-button:hover{color:var(--gold-bright);background:transparent;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}}
.display-group{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:#c8d1c6;font-size:11px}
.display-group select{min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:8px 25px 8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:6px;background:#1a2b35;font-size:10px}
.small-label{font-size:7px!important;letter-spacing:.035em;white-space:nowrap}
.help-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:-5px -8px 9px 0}
.help-heading>strong{color:var(--gold-bright);font:400 21px/1.2 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.help-heading button{min-width:42px;min-height:42px;padding:9px;border-color:transparent;color:#d5dfd1;background:transparent;font-size:23px;font-weight:400}
@media(hover:hover){.help-heading button:hover{border-color:#d7c6a32e;background:#ffffff06}}
.view-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px}
.caption-line{width:22px;height:1px;flex:none;background:#e1ceaa60}
.toast{position:absolute;z-index:40;bottom:125px;left:50%;width:max-content;max-width:calc(100% - 28px);transform:translateX(-50%);padding:11px 16px;border:1px solid #ddc59545;border-radius:8px;color:#f0eee2;background:#10212bf2;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0004;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
.sheet-close{display:none}
.show-controls{position:absolute;z-index:50;top:max(15px,env(safe-area-inset-top));right:max(15px,env(safe-area-inset-right));min-height:42px;padding:9px 13px;border-color:#ddc59536;border-radius:7px;color:#e5d2ae;background:#10212bcf;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font-size:10px}
.cinema .topbar,.cinema .bottom,.cinema .reader{display:none!important}
.main:has(>.world.cinema){grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.main:has(>.world.cinema)>.reader{display:none!important}
.world.full-active .mobile-settings{display:inline-flex}
.world.full-active .reader{position:absolute;top:15px;right:auto;bottom:15px;left:15px;width:280px;height:auto;max-height:calc(100% - 30px);border:1px solid #ddc59547;border-radius:12px;background:#13232df7;box-shadow:0 6px 28px #0005;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);transform:translateX(calc(-100% - 30px));visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:20}
.world.full-active .reader.open{transform:translateX(0);visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
.world.full-active .sheet-close{position:absolute;display:inline-grid;top:12px;right:11px;width:42px;min-width:42px;min-height:42px;margin:0;padding:9px;border-color:transparent;color:#dbe0d2;background:transparent;font-size:0}
.world.full-active .sheet-close::before{content:"×";font:400 24px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
.world.full-active .reader-head{padding-top:21px}
.world.full-active .reader-head .eyebrow{padding-right:35px}
.world.full-active .reader h1{padding-right:26px;font-size:32px}
.world.full-active .dock #zoomOut,.world.full-active .dock #zoomIn{grid-column:span 1}
.world.full-active .dock #reset,.world.full-active .dock #settingsToggle{grid-column:span 2}
@media(hover:hover){.world.full-active .sheet-close:hover{border-color:#d7c6a32e;background:#ffffff06}}
.noscript{position:fixed;z-index:1000;inset:0;display:grid;place-content:center;padding:25px;color:var(--gold);background:#10212b;font:400 24px/1.5 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;text-align:center}
@container(max-width:620px){.toast{bottom:176px}}
@media(max-width:760px),(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){
 .sheet-close{position:absolute;display:inline-grid;top:12px;right:11px;width:42px;min-width:42px;min-height:42px;margin:0;padding:9px;border-color:transparent;color:#dbe0d2;background:transparent;font-size:0}
 .sheet-close::before{content:"×";font:400 24px/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
 .actions #cinema{display:none}
 .actions:not(:has(>button:not(.icon))){display:flex;width:auto;max-width:none}
 .actions:not(:has(>button:not(.icon))) #help{padding:10px}
 .wide-button,.upload-buttons button,.text-button,.display-group{font-size:11px}
 .toggle-state{font-size:9px}.small-label{font-size:8px!important}
 .world.full-active .reader{top:auto;right:10px;bottom:10px;left:10px;width:auto;height:min(574px,calc(100% - 87px));max-height:calc(100% - 87px);border-radius:14px;transform:translateY(calc(100% + 20px))}
 .world.full-active .reader.open{transform:translateY(0)}
 .world.full-active .reader-head{padding:19px 21px 18px}.world.full-active .reader h1{padding-right:33px;font-size:29px}.world.full-active .sheet-close{top:12px;right:11px}
 .caption-line{width:14px}
}
@media(max-width:600px){.toast{bottom:177px}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){
 .world.full-active .reader{top:10px;right:10px;bottom:10px;left:auto;width:310px;height:calc(100% - 20px);max-height:none;border-radius:11px;transform:translateX(calc(100% + 20px))}
 .world.full-active .reader.open{transform:translateX(0)}
 .world.full-active .reader-head{padding:15px 20px 14px}.world.full-active .reader h1{font-size:26px}.world.full-active .sheet-close,.sheet-close{top:8px;right:9px}.toast{bottom:76px;font-size:10px}
}

.mark svg{width:22px;height:22px}.play-lines{display:none}#pauseMotion[aria-pressed="true"] .pause-lines{display:none}#pauseMotion[aria-pressed="true"] .play-lines{display:block}.actions button svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none}.dock #shake svg{width:16px;height:16px}#sourceImages{margin-top:1px}
.look-controls{margin-top:9px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.look-controls summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;min-height:44px;color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;list-style:none}
.look-controls summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.look-indicator{font-size:18px;line-height:1;transition:transform .16s ease}
.look-controls[open] .look-indicator{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.look-controls>.hint{margin:0;color:#a9b7b0;font-size:10px;line-height:1.65}
.look-pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,48px);grid-template-rows:repeat(2,44px);justify-content:center;gap:4px;margin:9px auto 12px}
.look-pad button{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:4px;font-size:20px;line-height:1}
#lookUp{grid-area:1/2}#lookLeft{grid-area:2/1}#lookDown{grid-area:2/2}#lookRight{grid-area:2/3}
@supports(overflow:clip){html,body,.app,.world{overflow:clip}}
.phone-motion{margin-top:14px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.sensor-actions{display:grid;gap:6px}
.sensor-actions button{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;padding:10px 11px;font-size:10px;text-align:left}
.sensor-actions #motionRecenter{color:var(--muted);background:#0e1b2373;border-color:var(--line)}
@media(hover:hover){.sensor-actions #motionRecenter:not(:disabled):hover{color:var(--gold-bright);background:#263b45;border-color:#d7c6a369}}
.phone-motion .motion-status,.phone-motion .hint{margin:9px 0 0;color:#a9b7b0;font-size:10px;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.phone-motion .motion-status{color:#d5c39f}
.phone-motion .motion-status+.hint{margin-top:5px}
.wide-button>span:first-child{min-width:0}
.control-group>.toggle-hint{margin:-2px 0 11px}
.music-track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;margin:0 0 8px;padding:12px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:#0c19216b}
.music-track-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:29px;height:34px;color:var(--gold)}
.music-track-icon svg{display:block;width:23px;height:23px}
.music-track>div{min-width:0}
.music-track-label{display:block;color:#9daea4;font-size:7px;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.095em}
#musicName{margin:4px 0 0;color:#e4dcc7;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.music-group>#musicChoose{justify-content:flex-start;padding:10px 11px;border-color:#ddc59542;color:var(--gold-bright);background:#ddc5950c;font-size:10px;text-align:left}
.music-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.music-actions button{min-width:0;padding:10px 5px;font-size:10px}
.music-group>#musicSave{justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:6px;padding:10px 11px;color:var(--gold);background:#0e1b2373;font-size:10px;text-align:left}
.music-download{display:block;margin-top:7px;padding:12px 11px;border:1px solid #dec18a70;border-radius:7px;color:#f1dcac;background:#d9bc7c16;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;text-decoration:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.music-download[hidden]{display:none}.music-download:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-bright);outline-offset:3px}
.music-group>.music-status{margin:9px 0 0;color:#d5c39f;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.music-group>.music-status+.hint{margin-top:6px}
@media(hover:hover){.music-group>#musicChoose:hover{border-color:#ddc5957a;background:#ddc59516}}
@media(max-width:760px),(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){.actions .button-label{display:none}.actions #pauseMotion,.actions #fullscreen,.actions #help{min-width:42px;width:42px;padding:10px}.actions{display:flex!important;grid-template-columns:none!important;max-width:none!important;width:auto!important;gap:5px}.actions #pauseMotion{grid-column:auto!important}.scene-card{max-width:calc(100% - 150px)}.dock #shake svg{width:14px;height:14px}}
@media(max-width:760px),(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){.sensor-actions button,.phone-motion .motion-status,.phone-motion .hint,.music-group>#musicChoose,.music-group>#musicSave,.music-actions button,#musicName{font-size:11px}.music-track-label{font-size:8px}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){.reader,.world.full-active .reader{width:min(310px,calc(100% - 20px));max-width:calc(100% - 20px)}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (max-width:600px){.dock{display:grid;width:min(100%,480px);grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:5px}.dock button,.dock button.icon{min-width:0;width:auto;padding:9px 5px}.dock #modeToggle,.dock #shake{grid-column:span 3}.dock #zoomOut,.dock #zoomIn{grid-column:span 1}.dock #reset,.dock #settingsToggle{grid-column:span 2}}
.mood-presets{display:grid;gap:6px}
.mood-presets button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px;min-height:46px;padding:8px 11px;border-color:#d7c6a32e;background:#1b2c35;text-align:left}
.mood-presets button span{color:#e7e4d7;font-size:11px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.4}
.mood-presets button small{color:#a9b7b0;font-size:9px;line-height:1.4}
.mood-presets button[aria-pressed="true"] span{color:#f0ddba}
.mood-status{margin:9px 0 0!important;color:#d5c39f!important;font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.6!important}
.mood-hint{margin:4px 0 14px!important}
@media(hover:hover){.mood-presets button:hover{background:#283d46;border-color:#ddc59563}}
@media(max-width:760px),(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){.mood-presets button span{font-size:12px}.mood-presets button small,.mood-status{font-size:10px!important}}

/* Portable projects and source-image downloads. */
.music-group>.music-example{justify-content:flex-start;gap:9px;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:10px 11px;border-color:#ddc5954d;color:var(--gold-bright);background:linear-gradient(115deg,#ddc59514,#ddc59506);font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;text-align:left}
.music-example>span:first-child{flex:none;color:var(--gold);font-size:18px;line-height:1}
.music-example>span:last-child{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.music-group>#musicChoose{margin-top:6px}
.music-group>.music-quiet{margin:9px 0 0;padding-left:10px;border-left:1px solid #ddc5955c;color:#d4c8ae;font-size:10px;line-height:1.65}
.music-group>.music-quiet+.hint{margin-top:8px}
.make-yours-group .hint b{color:#e1d3b6;font-weight:550}
.image-downloads{min-width:0;margin-top:13px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:8px;background:#09161d55}
.image-downloads summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 11px;color:#d6ccba;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;touch-action:manipulation}
.image-downloads summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.image-downloads summary::marker{content:""}
.image-downloads summary>span:first-child{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.details-plus{flex:none;width:16px;color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;line-height:1;text-align:center;transition:transform .16s ease}
.image-downloads[open] .details-plus{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.image-downloads[open] summary{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.image-download-content{min-width:0;padding:11px}
.image-download-content .download-intro{margin:0;color:#abbab1;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7}
.download-intro b{color:#d8cfbd;font-weight:550}
.download-set{min-width:0;margin-top:13px}
.download-set+.download-set{padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.download-set-label{margin:0;color:#ccb991;font-size:7px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.085em}
.download-set-note{margin:4px 0 7px;color:#9fafa5;font-size:9px;line-height:1.65}
.image-download{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:42px;margin-top:5px;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #d7c6a326;border-radius:6px;color:#e0d5bf;background:#15252e;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease}
.image-download>span:first-child{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.image-download>span:last-child{flex:none;color:#d9c494;font-size:15px}
.image-download:not([href]){opacity:.45;cursor:default}
.project-group{min-width:0}
.project-group .control-head{display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
.project-badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:7px;color:#8fa99c!important;font-size:7px!important;line-height:1.6!important;letter-spacing:.085em!important}
.project-intro{margin-bottom:14px;padding:12px 12px 13px;border:1px solid #ddc5952b;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#ddc5950e,#0b192061)}
.project-intro .project-intro-title{margin:0;color:#eee0c4;font:400 19px/1.3 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.project-intro>p+p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#b2bfb2;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7}
.picture-keepsake{margin:0 0 16px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:8px;background:#0e1b2355}
.picture-heading{margin:0;color:#ead7b3;font:400 17px/1.3 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
.picture-keepsake .hint,.picture-status{margin:6px 0 0;color:#b2bfb2;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6}
.picture-keepsake button,.picture-download{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;min-height:44px;margin-top:8px;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid #ddc5954d;border-radius:7px;color:var(--gold-bright);background:#1a2c36;font-size:11px;text-decoration:none}
.picture-download{background:#ddc59516}.picture-download:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-bright);outline-offset:3px}
.project-title-label{display:block;margin:0 0 6px;color:#d6ddcf;font-size:10px;line-height:1.6}
.project-title{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:42px;margin:0;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #ddc59542;border-radius:7px;color:#efe8d8;background:#0b1820;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px #0002;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;caret-color:var(--gold-bright)}
.project-title::placeholder{color:#889b93}
.project-group>.project-title-hint{margin:5px 0 0;color:#8fa398;font-size:9px;line-height:1.6}
.project-steps{display:grid;gap:11px;min-width:0;margin:16px 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.project-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:21px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:start;gap:9px;min-width:0;margin:0;padding:0}
.project-step-number{display:grid;place-items:center;width:21px;height:21px;border:1px solid #ddc59536;border-radius:50%;color:#d5c39e;background:#ddc59509;font-size:9px;line-height:1}
.project-steps li>span:last-child{min-width:0}
.project-steps b{display:block;color:#dce0d3;font-size:10px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5}
.project-steps small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#94a99b;font-size:9px;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.project-group>.project-primary{justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:44px;padding:11px 12px;border-color:#ddc595;color:#15252b;background:var(--gold);font-size:11px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.5;text-align:left}
.project-primary>span{flex:none;font-size:16px;line-height:1}
.project-downloads{display:grid;gap:6px;min-width:0;margin-top:7px}
.project-downloads:has(>a[hidden]):not(:has(>a:not([hidden]))){margin-top:0}
.project-download{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:53px;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #dec18a78;border-radius:7px;color:#eddbb9;background:#ddc59514;text-decoration:none;transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease}
.project-download>span:first-child{min-width:0}
.project-download b{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.project-download small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#a9bba8;font-size:8px;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.project-download>span:last-child{flex:none;color:var(--gold);font-size:18px;line-height:1}
.project-download-secondary{border-color:#d7c6a336;background:#0e1b2355}
.project-share-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;min-width:0;margin-top:7px}
.project-share-actions>button{min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:9px 6px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.project-share-actions>button:disabled{opacity:.5}
.project-group>.project-status{margin:9px 0 0;color:#d5c39f;font-size:10px;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.project-group>.project-summary{margin:5px 0 0;color:#91a59a;font-size:9px;line-height:1.6;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.project-summary:empty{display:none}
.project-load{min-width:0;margin-top:15px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.project-load-label{display:block;margin-bottom:7px;color:#9cac9d;font-size:7px;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.09em}
.project-load>button{justify-content:flex-start;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:10px 11px;border-color:#d7c6a33d;color:#d7d8c8;background:#0e1b2366;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;text-align:left}
.project-load .hint{margin:8px 0 0;color:#98ab9f;font-size:9px;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
:is(.image-downloads summary,.image-download,.project-download,.project-title,.project-group button,.music-example):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-bright);outline-offset:3px}
@media(hover:hover){
 .music-group>.music-example:hover{border-color:#ddc59580;background:#ddc5951b}
 .image-downloads summary:hover{color:var(--gold-bright);background:#ddc59507}
 .image-download[href]:hover{border-color:#ddc59563;background:#22343d}
 .project-group>.project-primary:hover{border-color:#ecdbb9;background:#ecdbb9}
 .project-download:hover{border-color:#e2c899aa;background:#ddc59520}
 .project-load>button:hover{border-color:#ddc59569;background:#263b45}
}
@media(max-width:760px),(max-height:500px) and (max-width:1000px){
 .music-group>.music-example,.music-group>.music-quiet,.image-downloads summary,.image-download-content .download-intro,.image-download,.project-title-label,.project-intro>p+p,.project-steps b,.project-group>.project-status,.project-share-actions>button,.project-load>button{font-size:11px}
 .download-set-label,.project-badge,.project-load-label{font-size:8px!important}
 .download-set-note,.project-steps small,.project-download small,.project-group>.project-summary,.project-load .hint,.project-group>.project-title-hint{font-size:10px}
 .project-title,.project-group>.project-primary{font-size:12px}
 .project-download b{font-size:11px}
 .project-title{font-size:16px}
}
@media(max-width:350px){
 .image-download-content{padding:10px}
 .image-download{padding:9px 8px}
 .project-intro{padding:11px}
 .project-share-actions{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
 .project-share-actions>button{justify-content:flex-start;padding:10px 11px;text-align:left}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.details-plus,.image-download,.project-download{transition:none}}
@media(forced-colors:active){.project-intro,.project-title,.project-step-number,.image-downloads,.image-download,.project-download{border:1px solid CanvasText}.project-group>.project-primary{color:ButtonText;background:ButtonFace;border:1px solid ButtonText}}

/* Quiet, legible controls that leave the winter world as the focus. */
:root {
  --sidebar: 296px;
  --muted: #bbc8c0;
  --quiet: #aabbb1;
}

header { border-bottom-color: #d7c6a32b; }
.brand-title, .brand strong { font-size: 10px; }
.brand-sub, .brand small, .offline { font-size: 9px; }
.reader { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #14232c, #111e27); }
.reader-head { padding: 20px 23px 18px; }
.reader h1 { margin: 8px 0 9px; font-size: 32px; }
.intro { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
.eyebrow { font-size: 9px; }
.controls { scrollbar-color: #a59674 #132029; }
.control-group { padding: 18px 0 20px; }
.control-group h3, .control-head h3 { color: #e2cda4; font-size: 10px; }
.control-head > span, .small-label { font-size: 9px !important; }
.control-group > p, .control-note, .phone-motion .motion-status, .phone-motion .hint {
  color: #becac2;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}
.phone-motion .motion-status { color: #ead5ae; }
.range-label, .range-row > label { color: #e1e8df; font-size: 12px; }
.range-value { font-size: 11px; }
.segmented button, .wide-button, .sensor-actions button, .upload-buttons button,
.text-button, .display-group, .display-group select, .music-actions button,
.music-group > #musicChoose, .music-group > #musicSave,
.music-group > .music-example, .image-downloads summary, .image-download,
.project-title-label, .project-share-actions > button, .project-load > button {
  font-size: 12px;
}
.segmented button, .sensor-actions button, .wide-button, .upload-buttons button,
.music-actions button, .project-share-actions > button { min-height: 44px; }
.toggle-state { font-size: 9px; }
.music-track-label, .download-set-label, .project-badge, .project-load-label { font-size: 9px !important; }
#musicName, .project-title, .project-group > .project-primary, .project-download b { font-size: 12px; }
.music-group > .music-quiet, .image-download-content .download-intro,
.project-intro > p + p, .project-steps b, .project-group > .project-status { font-size: 11.5px; }
.download-set-note, .project-steps small, .project-download small, .project-group > .project-summary,
.project-load .hint, .project-group > .project-title-hint { color: #adbbb0; font-size: 10.5px; }
.reader-foot { color: #d5c29b; font-size: 9px; }
.reader-foot span, .reader-foot p { font-size: 10px; }

.scene-card {
  border-color: #d7c6a335;
  background: #101e27e0;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px #0003;
}
.scene-card .eyebrow { font-size: 9px; }
.scene-card h2 { font-size: 22px; }
.scene-status { color: #d0d9d0; font-size: 10px; }
.actions button { font-size: 11px; }
.actions #fullscreen {
  color: #e6e3d6;
  background: #101e27e8;
  border-color: #dccfb530;
  font-weight: 500;
}
@media (hover: hover) {
  .actions #fullscreen:hover { color: #f2e6ce; background: #263b45; border-color: #d7c6a369; }
}
.dock { gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 12px; background: #0d1b24f2; }
.dock button { min-height: 44px; font-size: 11px; }
.dock #modeToggle {
  padding-inline: 16px;
  color: #17232b;
  border-color: #dfc89b;
  background: linear-gradient(140deg, #efddba, #d9bf8d);
  font-weight: 650;
}
@media (hover: hover) {
  .dock #modeToggle:hover { color: #17232b; border-color: #f4e3c5; background: #f1dfbd; }
}
.dock #modeToggle:active { background: #d1b57e; }
.dock #shake { color: #f0dfbf; border-color: #ddc59545; background: #ddc59513; }
.meta-line { color: #e3ebe1bd; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .07em; }
.help-panel { font-size: 12px; }
.help-panel .notice { font-size: 11px; }

@media (max-width: 760px), (max-height: 500px) and (max-width: 1000px) {
  .brand-title, .brand strong { font-size: 9px; }
  .brand-sub, .brand small, .offline { font-size: 8px; }
  .reader { background: #13232df7; }
  .reader-head { padding: 18px 21px 17px; }
  .reader h1 { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 29px; }
  .reader .eyebrow { font-size: 9px; }
  .controls { padding: 0 21px; }
  .control-group { padding: 18px 0 20px; }
  .control-group h3, .control-head h3 { font-size: 10px; }
  .control-group > p, .control-note, .phone-motion .motion-status, .phone-motion .hint { font-size: 12px; }
  .range-label, .range-row > label, .segmented button, .sensor-actions button,
  .wide-button, .upload-buttons button, .text-button, .display-group,
  .display-group select, .music-actions button, .music-group > #musicChoose,
  .music-group > #musicSave, .music-group > .music-example, .image-downloads summary,
  .image-download, .project-title-label, .project-share-actions > button,
  .project-load > button { font-size: 12px; }
  .project-title { font-size: 16px; }
  .scene-card .eyebrow { font-size: 9px; }
  .scene-card h2 { font-size: 20px; }
  .scene-status { font-size: 10px; }
  .actions button { min-height: 44px; }
  .actions #pauseMotion, .actions #fullscreen, .actions #help { width: 44px; min-width: 44px; }
  .scene-card { max-width: calc(100% - 155px); }
  .dock button { min-height: 44px; font-size: 11px; }
  .dock #modeToggle { padding-inline: 8px; }
  .meta-line { font-size: 9px; }
}
@media (max-width: 370px) {
  .brand-title, .brand strong { font-size: 8px; }
  .brand-sub, .brand small, .offline { font-size: 7px; }
  .scene-card h2 { font-size: 18px; }
  .scene-status { font-size: 9px; }
}
@media (max-height: 500px) and (max-width: 1000px) {
  .reader-head { padding: 15px 20px 14px; }
  .reader h1 { font-size: 26px; }
  .controls { padding: 0 20px; }
  .control-group { padding: 15px 0 17px; }
  .scene-card { max-width: 40%; }
}
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .dock #modeToggle { color: ButtonText; background: ButtonFace; border: 2px solid ButtonText; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
<header>
 <div class="brand"><span class="mark" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 2v20M3.34 7l17.32 10M3.34 17L20.66 7M9 4l3 3 3-3M9 20l3-3 3 3M4 10l4-1-1-4M20 14l-4 1 1 4M4 14l4 1-1 4M20 10l-4-1 1-4"/></svg></span><div><strong class="brand-title">THE SNOW GLOBE</strong><small class="brand-sub">A LITTLE WINTER WORLD</small></div></div>
 <div class="offline"><span class="status-dot"></span> THREE LAYERS · WORKS OFFLINE</div>
</header>
<main class="main">
<aside class="reader" id="settingsPanel" aria-label="Snow globe settings">
 <div class="reader-head"><div class="eyebrow">A world within glass</div><h1>Winter,<br> all around.</h1><p class="intro">A glowing village. A room beyond it.<br>Winter, held in a little world.</p><button class="sheet-close" id="closeSettings" aria-label="Close settings">Close settings ×</button></div>
 <div class="controls">
  <section class="control-group mood-group">
   <h3>SET THE MOOD</h3>
   <div class="mood-presets" role="group" aria-label="Atmosphere presets" aria-describedby="moodHint moodStatus">
    <button id="moodQuiet" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><span>Quiet snowfall</span><small>Soft flakes · slow turning</small></button>
    <button id="moodDance" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><span>Snow dance</span><small>Fuller flakes · faster turning</small></button>
    <button id="moodCozy" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><span>Cozy glow</span><small>Gentle snow · more room light</small></button>
   </div>
   <p class="mood-status" id="moodStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">Custom atmosphere.</p>
   <p class="hint mood-hint" id="moodHint">Choose a starting mood, then adjust any setting. Turning speed applies when a turn is enabled.</p>
  </section>
  <section class="control-group">
   <div class="control-head"><h3>01 &nbsp; YOUR VIEW</h3><span class="small-label">360° FREE LOOK</span></div>
   <div class="segmented" role="group" aria-label="Viewpoint"><button id="insideView" aria-pressed="true">Inside the globe</button><button id="outsideView" aria-pressed="false">In the room</button></div>
   <p class="hint" id="viewHint">Drag or swipe to look around, or use Tap to look below. Pinch, scroll or use − to zoom out further.</p>
   <details class="look-controls">
    <summary><span>Tap to look</span><span class="look-indicator" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary>
    <p class="hint">Tap an arrow to look around without dragging.</p>
    <div class="look-pad" role="group" aria-label="Look direction">
     <button type="button" id="lookUp" aria-label="Look up">↑</button>
     <button type="button" id="lookLeft" aria-label="Look left">←</button>
     <button type="button" id="lookDown" aria-label="Look down">↓</button>
     <button type="button" id="lookRight" aria-label="Look right">→</button>
    </div>
   </details>
   <div class="phone-motion" role="group" aria-label="Phone motion">
    <div class="sensor-actions"><button id="motionToggle" aria-pressed="false" aria-describedby="motionHint motionStatus">Enable phone motion</button><button id="motionRecenter" disabled aria-describedby="motionHint">Recenter tilt</button></div>
    <p class="motion-status" id="motionStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">Phone motion is off.</p>
    <p class="hint" id="motionHint">On a compatible phone, enable motion and grant access if asked. Sensors need a secure page. You can always use the Shake the globe button.</p>
   </div>
  </section>
  <section class="control-group">
   <h3>02 &nbsp; INDEPENDENT LAYERS</h3>
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="insideAngle">Village orientation</label><output class="range-value" for="insideAngle" id="insideValue">0°</output></div><input id="insideAngle" type="range" min="0" max="359" value="0" step="1">
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="outsideAngle">Surrounding room</label><output class="range-value" for="outsideAngle" id="outsideValue">0°</output></div><input id="outsideAngle" type="range" min="0" max="359" value="0" step="1">
   <button class="wide-button" id="autoOutside" aria-pressed="true" aria-describedby="autoRoomHint"><span>Turn room while inside</span><span class="toggle-state" id="autoLabel">ON</span></button>
   <p class="hint toggle-hint" id="autoRoomHint">The room turns while you are inside. Automatic room turning stops in room view.</p>
   <button class="wide-button" id="syncRotation" aria-pressed="false" aria-describedby="rotationHint"><span>Turn both layers together</span><span class="toggle-state" id="syncLabel">OFF</span></button>
   <button class="wide-button" id="autoInside" aria-pressed="false" aria-describedby="rotationHint"><span>Turn village &amp; snow in room view</span><span class="toggle-state" id="autoInsideLabel">OFF</span></button>
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="speed">Auto turning speed</label><output class="range-value" for="speed" id="speedValue">2.2°/s</output></div><input id="speed" type="range" min="0.3" max="6" step="0.1" value="2.2">
   <p class="hint" id="rotationHint">Inside, link the village and room to turn together. In room view, the village option turns the contents; the glass and base stay on the table as you look around.</p>
  </section>
  <section class="control-group">
   <h3>03 &nbsp; ATMOSPHERE</h3>
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="snowAmount">Falling snow</label><output class="range-value" for="snowAmount" id="snowValue">78%</output></div><input id="snowAmount" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="78">
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="snowVisibility">Snow clarity</label><output class="range-value" for="snowVisibility" id="visibilityValue">70%</output></div><input id="snowVisibility" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="70" aria-describedby="snowVisibilityHint">
   <p class="hint toggle-hint" id="snowVisibilityHint">Make individual flakes crisper and easier to see.</p>
   <button class="wide-button" id="autoSnow" aria-pressed="true" aria-describedby="autoSnowHint"><span>Fuller snow during auto rotation</span><span class="toggle-state" id="autoSnowLabel">ON</span></button>
   <p class="hint toggle-hint" id="autoSnowHint">Adds snowfall during auto rotation in either view. Set snow to 0% to stop it.</p>
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="glassAmount">Glass reflections</label><output class="range-value" for="glassAmount" id="glassValue">52%</output></div><input id="glassAmount" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="52">
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="roomAmount">Room through the glass</label><output class="range-value" for="roomAmount" id="roomValue">46%</output></div><input id="roomAmount" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="46">
   <button class="wide-button" id="linkedLighting" aria-pressed="true" aria-describedby="lightingHint"><span>Room light on the village</span><span class="toggle-state" id="linkedLabel">ON</span></button>
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="lightSpill">Room light strength</label><output class="range-value" for="lightSpill" id="lightValue">65%</output></div><input id="lightSpill" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="65" aria-describedby="lightingHint">
   <p class="hint" id="lightingHint">Cool window light and warm firelight follow the room as it turns.</p>
  </section>
  <section class="control-group music-group" aria-labelledby="musicHeading">
   <h3 id="musicHeading">04 &nbsp; MUSIC</h3>
   <div class="music-track"><span class="music-track-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13M9 9l12-2"/><ellipse cx="6" cy="18" rx="3" ry="2"/><ellipse cx="18" cy="16" rx="3" ry="2"/></svg></span><div><span class="music-track-label">YOUR WINTER SOUNDTRACK</span><p id="musicName">No music selected</p></div></div>
   <button id="musicExample" class="music-example" aria-describedby="musicHelp musicQuiet"><span aria-hidden="true">♪</span><span>Use Silent Night · music box</span></button>
   <button id="musicChoose" aria-describedby="musicHelp">Choose music</button>
   <input type="file" id="musicFile" aria-label="Choose a music file" accept="audio/*,.mp3,.m4a,.aac,.wav,.ogg,.opus,.flac,.webm,.aif,.aiff" hidden>
   <div class="music-actions"><button id="musicPlay" aria-pressed="false" disabled>Play music</button><button id="musicRemove" disabled>Remove music</button></div>
   <button id="musicSave" disabled>Save HTML with music</button><a id="musicDownload" class="music-download" hidden>Download HTML with music</a>
   <div class="range-row"><label class="range-label" for="musicVolume">Music volume</label><output class="range-value" for="musicVolume" id="musicVolumeValue">45%</output></div><input id="musicVolume" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="45">
   <p class="music-status" id="musicStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">Choose Silent Night or add your own looping music.</p>
   <p class="music-quiet" id="musicQuiet">A little music, only when you want it. Quiet until you press Play.</p>
   <p class="hint" id="musicHelp">Try the included music-box version of Silent Night or choose a local audio file. Music plays separately from visual motion. Prepare a project below to keep your chosen music with your world. MP3 has the widest support; other formats depend on your browser.</p>
   <audio id="musicAudio" hidden loop preload="metadata"></audio>
  </section>
  <section class="control-group make-yours-group" aria-labelledby="makeYoursHeading">
   <h3 id="makeYoursHeading">05 &nbsp; MAKE IT YOURS</h3>
   <div class="upload-buttons"><button id="replaceInside">Change village image</button><button id="replaceOutside">Change room image</button></div>
   <input type="file" id="insideFile" aria-label="Choose village panorama" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" hidden>
   <input type="file" id="outsideFile" aria-label="Choose room panorama" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" hidden>
   <p class="hint">Use a panoramic JPG, PNG or WebP. Glass stays separate. Use <b>Prepare project</b> below and download your copy before closing or reloading.</p>
   <button class="text-button" id="restoreImages">Restore enhanced scenery</button>
   <button class="text-button" id="sourceImages">Use original panoramas</button>
   <details class="image-downloads">
    <summary><span>Download panorama images</span><span class="details-plus" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary>
    <div class="image-download-content">
     <p class="download-intro">Take an image into your AI image tool, make it yours, then bring it back with <b>Change image</b> above.</p>
     <div class="download-set"><p class="download-set-label">YOUR ORIGINAL IMAGES</p><p class="download-set-note">The source strips, just as supplied.</p>
      <a id="downloadOriginalInside" class="image-download" download><span>Original village strip</span><span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
      <a id="downloadOriginalOutside" class="image-download" download><span>Original room strip</span><span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
      <a id="downloadOriginalGlass" class="image-download" download><span>Original glass image</span><span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
     </div>
     <div class="download-set"><p class="download-set-label">ENHANCED PANORAMAS</p><p class="download-set-note">Full 2:1 scenes. Files keep their actual JPEG, PNG or WebP format.</p>
      <a id="downloadEnhancedInside" class="image-download" download><span>Enhanced village · 2:1</span><span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
      <a id="downloadEnhancedOutside" class="image-download" download><span>Enhanced room · 2:1</span><span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
     </div>
    </div>
   </details>
  </section>
  <section class="control-group project-group" aria-labelledby="projectHeading">
   <div class="control-head"><h3 id="projectHeading">06 &nbsp; SAVE &amp; SHARE</h3><span class="project-badge">TAKE WINTER WITH YOU</span></div>
   <div class="project-intro"><p class="project-intro-title">Keep this little world.</p><p>Your images, chosen music, view and atmosphere travel together.</p></div>
   <div class="picture-keepsake"><p class="picture-heading">Save a picture</p><p class="hint">Capture the current view and snow as a PNG, without the controls.</p><button id="capturePicture" aria-describedby="pictureStatus" disabled>Prepare picture</button><a id="pictureDownload" class="picture-download" download="Snow_Globe.png" hidden>Download picture ↓</a><p id="pictureStatus" class="picture-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">Prepare a picture whenever you like your view.</p></div>
   <label class="project-title-label" for="projectTitle">Project name</label>
   <input id="projectTitle" class="project-title" type="text" value="My winter world" maxlength="80" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" aria-describedby="projectTitleHint">
   <p class="hint project-title-hint" id="projectTitleHint">Give your saved world a name.</p>
   <ol class="project-steps" aria-label="How to save and share">
    <li><span class="project-step-number" aria-hidden="true">1</span><span><b>Prepare your project</b><small>Gather your images, music and settings.</small></span></li>
    <li><span class="project-step-number" aria-hidden="true">2</span><span><b>Download or share</b><small>Keep a copy, or send your little world.</small></span></li>
    <li><span class="project-step-number" aria-hidden="true">3</span><span><b>Open it anywhere</b><small>Open the HTML in a browser, or load the project on the website.</small></span></li>
   </ol>
   <button id="projectPrepare" class="project-primary" aria-describedby="projectStatus">Prepare project <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
   <div class="project-downloads" aria-label="Prepared project downloads">
    <a id="projectDownload" class="project-download" download hidden><span><b>Download complete HTML</b><small>Open in a browser · works offline</small></span><span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
    <a id="projectDataDownload" class="project-download project-download-secondary" download hidden><span><b>Download project file</b><small>Load on the website · Snowglobe JSON</small></span><span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
   </div>
   <div class="project-share-actions"><button id="projectSend" disabled>Share project</button><button id="projectOpenWebsite" disabled>Open on website</button></div>
   <p class="project-status" id="projectStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">Prepare a project to make your download and sharing options ready.</p>
   <p class="project-summary" id="projectSummary"></p>
   <div class="project-load"><span class="project-load-label">HAVE A SAVED WORLD?</span><button id="projectLoad">Load project</button><input id="projectFile" type="file" accept=".html,.json,.snowglobe,application/json,text/html" aria-label="Choose a saved snow-globe project" hidden><p class="hint">Choose a saved HTML or project file. Music stays quiet until you press Play.</p></div>
  </section>
  <section class="control-group display-group"><label for="quality">Display quality</label><select id="quality"><option value="auto">Balanced</option><option value="battery">Battery saver</option><option value="high">Sharper</option></select></section>
 </div>
 <div class="reader-foot">THREE SCENES. ONE SMALL WORLD.<br><span>No connection needed after downloading.</span></div>
</aside>
<section class="world" id="world" aria-label="Interactive snow-globe panorama">
 <canvas id="panorama" tabindex="0" aria-label="Snow-globe panorama. Drag to look around and up or down, arrow keys to look, plus or minus to zoom, Home to reset the view or find the globe."></canvas>
 <div class="topbar"><div class="scene-card"><div class="eyebrow" id="sceneEyebrow">WITHIN THE GLASS</div><h2 id="sceneTitle">The winter village</h2><div class="scene-status" id="sceneStatus">A separate room, beyond the glass.</div></div><div class="actions"><button id="pauseMotion" class="motion-button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Pause or resume motion" title="Pause or resume motion"><svg class="motion-symbol" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><g class="pause-lines"><path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14"/></g><path class="play-lines" d="m9 5 10 7-10 7V5Z"/></svg><span class="button-label">Pause motion</span></button><button id="help" class="icon" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="helpPanel" aria-label="Help and panorama information" title="Help"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M9.5 9a2.6 2.6 0 0 1 5 1c0 2-2.5 2-2.5 4M12 17h.01"/></svg></button><button id="cinema" class="cinema-button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Hide interface for an unobstructed view" title="Hide controls"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7S2 12 2 12Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg><span class="button-label">Hide controls</span></button><button class="primary" id="fullscreen" aria-label="Toggle fullscreen" title="Fullscreen"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 3H3v5M16 3h5v5M3 16v5h5M21 16v5h-5"/></svg><span class="button-label">Fullscreen</span></button></div></div>

 <div class="help-panel" id="helpPanel" hidden><div class="help-heading"><strong>Explore your snow globe</strong><button id="closeHelp" aria-label="Close help">×</button></div><p><b>Inside the globe</b> places you among the village and falling snow. <b>In the room</b> reveals the whole glass globe and its brass base.</p><p>Drag or swipe in either view to look left, right, up and down. In room view, the globe stays on the table and can leave the screen as you look away. Choose <b>Find the globe</b> to return to it. Pinch, scroll or use + / − to zoom; use − to pull back for a wider view. With the panorama focused, arrow keys look around and Home resets the camera.</p><p><b>Turn room while inside</b> gently rotates the room beyond the glass. Enable <b>Turn both layers together</b> to bring the village along. In room view, <b>Turn village &amp; snow</b> rotates the little winter world inside the stationary globe; <b>Fuller snow</b> adds snowfall as it turns. The two orientation sliders also work independently. <b>Snow clarity</b> makes individual flakes crisper and easier to see.</p><p><b>Room light on the village</b> brings cool window light and warm firelight into the snow, following the room’s orientation. Adjust its strength under Atmosphere.</p><p><b>Shake the globe</b> sends the snow swirling and always works without phone sensors. For sensors, choose <b>Enable phone motion</b>, grant access if asked, then shake or tilt gently. Hold your phone comfortably and choose <b>Recenter tilt</b> to set a new neutral position. Sensors need a compatible device and browser, permission where required, and a secure page such as HTTPS. Use the button if sensors are unavailable. <b>Pause motion</b> freezes rotation, snow and sensor-driven effects.</p><p><b>Use Silent Night · music box</b> selects the optional included track, or <b>Choose music</b> adds a local audio file that loops. Choose <b>Play music</b> to start it, and use its separate playback and volume controls. Music keeps playing when visual motion is paused. Nothing plays automatically when a project opens. Audio format support depends on your browser; MP3 is the most widely supported choice, and some codecs may not play.</p><p><b>Prepare project</b> gathers your images, chosen music, view and atmosphere into a portable copy. Download the complete HTML to open it directly in a browser, or download the project file to use <b>Load project</b> on the website. The sharing and website buttons become available after preparation. Prepare and download a fresh copy after making changes. Your recipient can open the HTML in a browser or load the project on the website, then press <b>Play music</b> to listen.</p><p class="notice">The enhanced scenes are AI-expanded 2:1 panoramas based on your images, with a transparent village skyline, detailed snow terrain and a complete room. Choose “Use original panoramas” to return to your original narrow strips. Glass optics, lighting and snowfall are simulated. You can look around this layered panorama; the village has no walkable 3D geometry.</p><p class="notice" id="rendererNote">Both enhanced scenes and all three original images are built into this file. Your replacement images are read locally.</p></div>
